svg.text: Every service and how it connects. Numbers follow the prompt-to-live flow in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
CONTROL PLANE · KUBERNETES (LYZR CLOUD OR CUSTOMER VPC)
the harness: plan · write · run · fix
adds the user's token at call time

Flow: 1 prompt · 2 queue a job · 3 model calls via the LLM gateway · 4 connect tools (OAuth → vault) · 5 warm sandbox · 6 agent loop in the sandbox · 7 live preview · 8 GitHub commit / PR · 9 deploy · 10 live traffic
Proxies: preview proxy (people → sandboxes) · LLM gateway (agents → models) · egress proxy (sandboxes → internet) · tool proxy (apps → SaaS) · app edge router (internet → live apps)
Rules: user code never runs in the control plane · sandboxes are disposable (state lives in Postgres, object storage, git) · dev and prod never share machines, databases or secrets
